author: Acceqted
body:
Reporting A Teamspeak User...



Have you noticed a naughty teamspeak user? Feel someone wasn't punished and should be? Caught a rule breaker? 

This is where we want you to report them. All reports are directly forwarded and only seen by Teamspeak Developers, Admins and the legendary owner himself, Funky. Please use the correct format while reporting a player as it is easier for us to organize and read, cheers!


Format:

Player's Teamspeak Name:
Rule Broken: 
Evidence:
Any additional notes:


Notes!

~ This is not the place to report staff members.
~ If you choose not to follow the format it will be automatically denied.
~ You may not request a certain teamspeak developer to look at your report, we all decide as a team.
~ Evidence must be included for your report to be valid.
